purpose: Additive source-pixel focus views for sparse world overviews; original full previews preserved.
method: Reconstruct complete scene using the verified original-pixel renderer, confirm full RGBA hash against the full preview manifest, crop at recorded integer pixel bounds, then resize to at most 480 pixels. Contact sheet labels separate authored spaces.

crops.label: Island exterior

crops.bounds_semantics: left/top inclusive, right/bottom exclusive; pixels in the full authored TMJ canvas
crops.bounds_basis: ground-and-objects layer bounds; foreground and authored inlays retained

output.resampling: Lanczos; aspect ratio retained; no color adjustment
